language.title: Language
language.description: The language you read HelmSmart in. Your own choice — it does not change what your customers receive.

general.entityTypeHelp: Contact support to change entity type. Billing rates are under the Financial tab.

weeklyDigest.label: Weekly digest email
weeklyDigest.help: A Monday summary of cash, receivables, bills, and tasks — emailed to owners & admins.

englishAssist.label: Show me English (multi-language assist)
englishAssist.help: Translate non-English customer messages to English in your inbox, and send replies & reminders bilingually (their language + English) so you can read what went out.

bank.description: Link a bank via Plaid to import the last 90 days of transactions (AI-categorized), then map each account to a chart-of-accounts entry so it posts to the double-entry journal.
bank.empty: No bank accounts linked yet — use the Link Bank button above to connect one.

rates.hourlyHelp: Your billable rate — applied automatically when starting a timer.
rates.laborCostHelp: What an hour of work costs you (wages/contractor pay). Used for project profit.

reminders.title: Automatic payment reminders
reminders.description: Automatically email clients about overdue invoices on a schedule
reminders.intervalsLabel: Send reminders when overdue by (days, comma-separated)
reminders.intervalsHelp: Example: 3, 7, 14, 30 sends reminders at 3, 7, 14, and 30 days overdue
reminders.maxLabel: Stop after this many reminders per invoice

errors.noDays: Enter at least one reminder day (e.g. 3, 7, 14)

marketing.socialChannelsDescription: Connect the accounts your AI marketing posts to. Connecting opens the provider's secure sign-in; disconnecting removes the stored access here.
marketing.socialAutopilotDescription: Turn it on and Emily writes & schedules posts about your business on the cadence you choose.

slack.description: Get notified in Slack for leads, calls, and approvals
slack.webhookHelp: In your Slack app: Features → Incoming Webhooks → Add New Webhook to Workspace. Copy the URL here.

slack_notify_new_lead.label: New lead added
slack_notify_new_lead.description: When a client is created manually or via form

slack_notify_form_submission.label: Form submission
slack_notify_form_submission.description: When someone submits a lead capture form

slack_notify_missed_call.label: Missed call
slack_notify_missed_call.description: When the AI receptionist logs a missed inbound call

slack_notify_approval.label: AI approval needed
slack_notify_approval.description: When an AI employee action requires your approval

test.blockText:
✅ *HelmSmart is connected to Slack!*
You'll receive notifications here for new leads, missed calls, form submissions, and AI approvals.

errors.notAuthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.invalidUrl: Must be a valid Slack incoming webhook URL (hooks.slack.com)
errors.testSendFailed: Failed to send test message. Check your webhook URL.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Manage who has access to your workspace

invite.title: Invite a team member
invite.sent: Invitation sent to {{email}}. They have 7 days to accept.

team.removeConfirm: Remove this team member? They will lose access immediately.

errors.notAuthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.invitePending: An active invitation is already pending for this email

errors.orgUpdateRefused: Couldn't save — you may not have permission for this organization.

errors.createFailed: Failed to create organization. Please try again.
errors.membershipFailed: Organization created but membership failed. Contact support.
